content.short: Create Web3 dApp is an npx package to build a dApp from simple to feature-rich in minutes.
content.description: Create Web3 DApp is an npx package that lets developers build anything from a simple, barebones dApp to a full-featured decentralized platform in about 2 minutes. This Next.js-based framework supports major blockchains such as Ethereum, Polygon, Optimism, Arbitrum, and Solana, helping Web3 teams ship production-ready applications quickly using pre-built React components, webhooks, and APIs. For more information, consult the project documentation.
